name: Halloween Party at Grendel's
source:
Hazel receives a mysterious call on a night when she stays up until midnight working. Damian, her college friend and secret crush, invites her to a Halloween party at his family's mansion. Hazel is happy to finally have some fun and spend time with her crush, but things don't go as she expected.

The Grendel family has secrets of their own and they are not very friendly to strangers.

Will Hazel be able to find her crush and express her feelings to him? Or does the Grendel mansion have other plans for her? 

[From [url=https://devilinlovegames.itch.io/halloween-party-at-grendels]itch.io[/url]]
